Spear Street Technology, which developed personal AI assistant Instinct, is in talks to raise $1B at a valuation of about $10B, the Information reported.
Instinct’s numbers of users exceed 100,000 and now bring about capacity constraints. Sequoia Capital and Benchmark have been in talks to lead the financing, the report said.
Instinct raised $250M Series B at a $2.5B valuation in August.

title: Spear Street’s Instinct in talks to raise $1B at $10B valuation: report
